name: Alvopetro Energy Ltd.
summary: Alvopetro Energy Ltd. engages in the acquisition, exploration, development, and production of hydrocarbons in the Recôncavo basins in onshore Brazil. As of December 31, 2020, the company holds interests in the Caburé and Gomo natural gas assets; two oil fields, including Bom Lugar and Mãe-da-lua; and two other exploration assets comprising 23,527 acres. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.
